1016.description: A wrist curl with a band, curling the wrists upward. It strengthens the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing up, and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝上，前臂放在大腿上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1080.description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

1144.description: Standing with the straps, you lean forward and roll out with straight arms, a challenging core move.
instructions: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

1208.description: A diagonal cable rotation from high to low that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
instructions: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1272.description: A chest stretch using an exercise ball held out in front. It loosens the chest.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the exercise ball with both hands and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Slowly bring the exercise ball towards your chest, feeling a stretch in your chest muscles.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住健身球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将健身球移向胸部，感受胸部肌肉的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1336.description: A stability ball back extension where you add a twist at the top. It trains the lower back, glutes and obliques.
instructions: Start by lying face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Return to the center and repeat the rotation to the other side.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，面朝下躺在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双脚牢牢踩在地面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将躯干旋转到一侧，保持臀部和腿部稳定。
返回中心并重复旋转到另一侧。
将上半身放低至起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

1400.description: Squatting down and then kicking one leg out to the side. It trains the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and kick your right leg out to the side.
Return the foot to the floor and drop into the next squat.
Alternate sides each rep.

1464.description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled, shown from behind. It loads the quads and glutes with your back supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the sled machine so that your knees are at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards your body, controlling the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整雪橇机的座椅，使膝盖成45度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
握住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展双腿，将脚踏板推离身体，脚后跟保持在脚踏板上。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将踏板放回到身体的方向，控制动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

1528.description: A clean caught above parallel, started from blocks. It builds explosive power.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull and catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1592.description: A bounding jump from one leg to the other leg. It develops power and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap forward as far as you can.
Land on the opposite leg and absorb the impact with a soft knee.
Hold the landing for a moment to stay balanced.
Repeat, alternating legs or staying on one side.

1656.description: A dumbbell biceps curl while sitting on a bosu ball with your legs in a V. It trains the biceps and the core.
instructions: Sit on a bosu ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your arms fully extended down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在博苏球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂在身体两侧完全向下伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1720.description: A lying barbell triceps extension that lowers the bar behind your head. It stretches and builds the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1784.description: A partner pulls your arms backward to deepen the chest stretch. It works well when you want more range than you get alone.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1848.description: A static calf stretch that lengthens the lower leg muscles and the Achilles area.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1912.description: A hamstring stretch with the foot raised high and the knee slightly bent for a deeper but friendlier pull.
instructions: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1976.description: Stretching one arm back and down to lengthen the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2104.description: Targets the lower calf and Achilles tendon area by leaning into a wall with the back heel pressed down and the knee bent.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

2296.description: Rolling a ball forward with your forearms to challenge the abs and core stability.
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
Repeat slowly.

2360.description: A side-by-side form check for knee position midway through a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and begin to squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees keep tracking in line with your toes on the way up and down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2424.description: A lunge with band resistance that works the legs and glutes.
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso tall.
Push through your front heel to return.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.

2616.description: A lat pulldown with a v-bar attachment. Builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit down on the cable pulldown machine and grab the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip.
Adjust the knee pad so that your thighs are secured under it.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the v-bar down towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the v-bar to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在电缆下拉机上，用正手抓住 V 形杆附件。
调整护膝，使大腿固定在其下方。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜。
将 V 形杆向下拉至上胸部，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢地将 v 形杆返回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

2744.description: A standing hip thrust against cable resistance, training hip extension and the glutes.
instructions: Attach a belt or strap to a low cable and stand facing away from the stack.
Hold the cable at your hips with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge slightly, then thrust your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Return slowly and keep your ribs down.

2808.description: A sumo-stance dumbbell pull through between the legs. Trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed outwards.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Lower the dumbbell down between your legs, keeping your arms straight.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips forward, pulling the dumbbell up and in front of your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbell back down between your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
双手握住哑铃置于身体前方，双臂伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将臀部放低至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直。
将哑铃放在两腿之间，保持手臂伸直。
通过脚后跟发力，向前伸展臀部，将哑铃向上拉至身体前方。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部，然后将哑铃放回双腿之间。
重复所需的重复次数。

2872.description: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

2936.description: Rocking forward over a bent knee to open the ankle and calf. It helps ankle mobility for squats and walking.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

3000.description: A standing calf stretch with a band around the forward foot, pulling the toes back to lengthen the Achilles area.
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.

3128.description: Turning the sole of the foot inward against a band to train the muscles on the inner side of the ankle.
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3256.description: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

3320.description: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.

3384.description: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.
instructions: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

3448.description: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

3512.description: A dead bug with a band held in the hands, pulling it as the arms move. It builds core stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.

3576.description: Walk while holding heavy kettlebells at your sides to build grip, posture and total body stability.
instructions: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.

3640.description: A crunch where the opposite hand reaches toward the knee on each rep. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and reach your right hand towards your left knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat, this time reaching your left hand towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，并将右手伸向左膝盖。
返回起始位置并重复，这次将左手伸向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3704.description: A squat followed by two quick jumps in a row. It builds explosive leg power and stamina.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

3768.description: A seated leg press on a lever machine that builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safety and press the platform away.
Stop just before your knees lock.
Lower the weight slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your hips down and your back flat on the pad.

3832.description: A hang from a sloped hangboard hold. It builds finger and forearm strength for climbing.
instructions: Grip the sloped hold with open hands.
Step off the ground and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders active and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully, then repeat.

3896.description: A seated row with a band that works the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

3960.description: A flowing bodyweight move that goes from a pike with hips high to a cobra with chest lifted. It warms up the shoulders, spine and hamstrings.
instructions: Start on hands and toes with your hips high in an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and glide your chest forward and down between your hands.
Sweep forward and up, straightening your arms and lifting your chest into a cobra.
Keep your legs active and look slightly forward.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up into the pike, and repeat smoothly.

4024.description: A light band warm-up that presses the arms overhead to wake up the shoulders before training.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band with both hands at chest height.
Keep a slight tension in the band.
Raise your arms overhead in a smooth arc.
Lower back to chest height slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without shrugging.

4088.description: A hammer-style curl that crosses the band toward the opposite shoulder, hitting the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Curl one hand across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower under control, then repeat on the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

4152.description: A biceps curl with the dumbbells held close together. This emphasises the outer biceps through a controlled curl.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells with palms forward and hands close together.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid swinging your torso.

4216.description: Swing from bar to bar along a horizontal ladder. It builds grip, shoulders and back with a playful challenge.
instructions: Grab the first bar with both hands and hang.
Swing your body slightly and reach for the next bar with one hand.
Release the back hand and reach for the following bar.
Keep a steady rhythm using your hips for momentum.
Continue to the end of the ladder.
Drop down softly and rest before the next pass.

4280.description: A standing stretch where you reach up and look toward the ceiling to open the front of the body. It opens the hips and thighs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.

4344.description: An incline version of the skull crusher, lowering a barbell behind your head to hit the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell above your chest, arms straight.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

4408.description: A vertical pull with a kettlebell that works the shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep it close to your body.
Pull it up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

4472.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the side of the glutes (gluteus medius). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your side of the glutes (gluteus medius) while lying on your side or leaning on a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4536.description: A bent-over row with elbows flared to hit the rear shoulders. It builds upper back and posture muscles.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4600.description: Rolling a small ball under your lower back to release tight spots and loosen the muscles beside the spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.

4728.description: A bench dip with a dumbbell resting on your lap for extra load. It hits the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a bench edge, hands beside your hips, and slide your hips off the front.
Rest a dumbbell on your thighs, holding it steady with your hips and legs.
Bend your elbows to lower until they reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.

4792.description: A one-legged hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, a second variation. It hits the glutes hard without any equipment.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4856.description: A close-grip bench press from pins. It builds triceps strength off the dead stop.
instructions: Set the bar on pins at chest height.
Lie on the bench and grip the bar shoulder-width.
Press the bar up.
Lock out your elbows.
Lower back to the pins.

4920.description: A ring pull up where your feet on the floor help you up. It is a good step toward full pull ups.
instructions: Hold the rings with a firm grip and stand with a bend in the knees.
Place your feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your elbows down and your chest between the rings.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower with control.
Keep your core tight.

4984.description: An easier knee-supported version of the hindu push up. The flowing dip and sweep trains the chest, shoulders and triceps and opens the spine.
instructions: Start on your knees and hands with hips high, like a pike.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Push through your arms to glide your chest up and forward, arching slightly.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up to the start.
Move smoothly and keep your core engaged.

5048.description: Lying face down, lift your body and move your arms from a W to a Y. It trains the whole back side.
instructions: Lie face down, arms in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward into a Y.
Return to the W while keeping the lift.
Lower fully after your reps.

5240.description: Deadlifting an EZ bar and finishing with a curl. It combines a hip hinge and an arm exercise.
instructions: Stand with an EZ bar in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it and repeat.

5304.description: Squat while standing inside a trap bar, which keeps the load at your sides. Builds legs and glutes with a friendly upright torso.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

5496.description: Goblet squat with your heels raised on a plate or wedge so the knees travel forward and the quads work harder.
instructions: Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

5816.description: A one-arm press done lying on your side on a bench. It targets the chest while the core resists rolling.
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

5880.description: A combo move that pairs a goblet-style front squat with a calf raise at the top, working the legs from hips to ankles.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.

5944.description: A one-arm dumbbell front raise using a hammer grip, targeting the front deltoid with less wrist strain.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.

6008.description: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

6072.description: A high row pulling bottles up toward your armpits. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

6136.description: A bent-over movement where you pull the shoulder blades together with straight arms. It builds the mid-back muscles that stabilize the shoulders.
instructions: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending the elbows.
Hold for a moment.
Release the blades and let the weights drop slightly.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

6264.description: A hammer curl lying face down on an incline bench, alternating arms. It builds the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your elbows still.

6328.description: A deep split squat holding dumbbells at your sides, great for loading the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

6392.description: A lat pulldown using a magnetic grip handle that builds the wide muscles of your back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

6584.description: A bench press with your feet flat on the bench or surface instead of the floor, limiting leg drive and focusing on the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.

6648.description: A rope pull toward the face from a high pulley. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.

6776.description: A one-arm cable row with a high elbow. It focuses on the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

7416.description: Standing cable fly with palms facing each other to squeeze the chest.
instructions: Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

7864.description: A machine overhead triceps extension. The lever path keeps the movement smooth and the focus on the triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.

9272.description: Sitting on the floor, you pull your toes toward your shins to work the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.

9848.description: A standing hip thrust on a lever machine. It targets the glutes with a smooth, guided path.
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down.

10040.description: A raise where each dumbbell sweeps across the front of your body. It trains the front delts and upper chest.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

10168.description: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.
instructions: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

10552.description: Rotate your torso side to side with a medicine ball in a split stance. It trains the trunk rotators.
instructions: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

10744.description: A seated hamstring stretch with a band around your foot. The band lets you control the pull.
instructions: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

10936.description: Passing a stick overhead and around the body. It opens up the shoulders.
instructions: Hold a stick with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead with straight arms.
Continue the arc behind your back as far as comfortable.
Return along the same path.
Narrow your grip over time.

11256.description: A bench press using cables. The steady tension gives your chest and triceps constant work.
instructions: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

0056.description: A lying triceps extension with a close grip, lowering the bar toward the forehead and pressing it back.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing up.
Extend your arms fully, lifting the barbell above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
紧握杠铃，双手与肩同宽，掌心向上。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃举至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0120.description: An upright row with the barbell pulled toward the chin. Works the delts and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将杠铃笔直向上举向下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0184.description: Lying on a bench, you take a rope overhead and back in an arc with straight arms. It stretches and trains the lats and chest.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine and set the pulley at the highest position.
Lie down on a bench with your head towards the cable machine.
Hold the rope with both hands and extend your arms straight up above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the rope behind your head while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise the rope back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到缆绳机上，并将滑轮设置在最高位置。
躺在长凳上，头朝向电缆机。
双手握住绳子，将双臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持双臂伸直，在保持控制的同时慢慢将绳子放到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将绳子拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0248.description: A barbell row done lying face down on a bench. The bench removes lower back strain so the upper back does the pulling.
instructions: Set up a barbell on the floor and lie face down on a bench with your chest just off the edge.
Reach down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
With your legs straight and feet on the ground, lift the barbell off the floor by extending your arms.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在地板上放一个杠铃，脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部刚好离开边缘。
向下伸手，正手抓住杠铃，距离略宽于肩宽。
双腿伸直，双脚着地，伸展双臂，将杠铃提离地面。
将杠铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0312.description: A hammer curl with a neutral grip. It works the biceps and the forearms, especially the brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂静止，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

0376.description: You lift dumbbells in front of you or to the side with straight arms. A simple shoulder builder.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地板平行，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0504.description: A jumping jack combined with an overhead press. It raises your heart rate and works the shoulders and legs together.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Jump your feet out wide as you press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out the arms without arching your back.
Jump your feet together as you lower the weights to your shoulders.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

0568.description: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench. It hits the obliques and builds side-body stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

0632.description: A glute bridge with your feet close together on a bench. It places more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet close together on a bench.
Bend your knees and keep arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

0696.description: Lying on your back, you slide your heels toward your glutes to train the hamstrings. Uses only your body weight.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips off the ground, engaging your glutes and hamstrings.
Slowly curl your legs towards your glutes, keeping your hips lifted.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Lower your hips back down to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将臀部抬离地面，锻炼臀肌和腿筋。
慢慢地将双腿向臀部弯曲，保持臀部抬起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿伸展回起始位置。
将臀部放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

0760.description: A leg press done on a smith machine setup, pushing the footplate away with both legs. It builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplate of the smith machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grasp the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from you by extending your legs, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards you, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机的座椅和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
伸展双腿，使背部紧靠靠背，将脚踏板推离您。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将脚踏板向您的方向放低，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0952.description: Balance on one leg with the torso and top leg extended sideways. It strengthens the standing leg and hips and tests your balance.
instructions: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.
